title: 3556. Sum of Largest Prime Substrings

examples.explanation: The unique prime numbers formed from the substrings of "12234" are 2, 3, 23, 223, and 1223. The 3 largest primes are 1223, 223, and 23. Their sum is 1469.
The unique prime number formed from the substrings of "111" is 11. Since there is only one prime number, the sum is 11.
